<h2 style="font-size: 0.8em;"> Repérez sur le graphe un domaine ou une école dans le menu déroulant</h2>

```{r context="server", out.width="100%"}
library(visNetwork)
library(shiny)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
devtools::load_all()
library(cpge)






##mat= read.table("https://valerierobert-maths.re/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/ec.txt", header=TRUE)

graph <- data_graph()
nodes=graph$nodes
edges=graph$edges
only_domaine=graph$only_domaine
only_ecoles=graph$only_ecoles
only_concours=graph$only_concours

  output$graph<-renderVisNetwork({
visNetwork(nodes, edges) %>%
  visEdges(color = list(
    inherit = FALSE  
  )) %>%
     visPhysics(
    solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
    forceAtlas2Based = list(
      avoidOverlap = 4.0,           # augmente fortement l’espacement
      springLength = 20,           # plus de distance entre nœuds et groupes
      springConstant = 0.005,        # rigidité des liens légèrement réduite pour plus de flexibilité
      gravitationalConstant = -20, # plus de répulsion entre groupes
      centralGravity = 0.01,
      damping = 0.5                  # stabilise le réseau rapidement
    )
  ) %>%
  #  visPhysics(
  #   enabled = TRUE,
  #   solver = "barnesHut",
  #   barnesHut = list(
  #     gravitationalConstant = -2600,
  #     centralGravity = 0.1,
  #     springLength = 290,
  #     springConstant = 0.04,
  #     damping = 0.35,     # mouvement lent et stable
  #     avoidOverlap = 1.5  # aucun chevauchement
  #   )
  # )%>%
  visLegend(useGroups = TRUE, position = "right") %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el){
      var legend = el.querySelector('.vis-legend');
      if(legend){
        // Bloquer taille
        legend.style.width = '220px';
        legend.style.maxWidth = '220px';
        legend.style.minWidth = '220px';
        legend.style.overflow = 'hidden';
        legend.style.flex = '0 0 220px';

        // Position absolue pour qu'elle ne suive pas le zoom/pan
        legend.style.position = 'absolute';
        legend.style.top = '10px';
        legend.style.right = '10px';
        legend.style.pointerEvents = 'none'; // empêche clics/drag sur légende
      }
    }
  ")%>%
     
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el){
      // cibler le select du selectedBy
      var selects = el.querySelectorAll('select');
      selects.forEach(function(sel){
        sel.style.fontSize = '12px';    // taille du texte
        sel.style.height = '24px';      // hauteur du menu
        sel.style.width = '170px';      // largeur du menu
      });
    }
  ") %>%
      #"#2F5FD7"
    #"#9e9992"
       # visPhysics(stabilization = TRUE,
    #solver = "forceAtlas2Based",
    #forceAtlas2Based = list(gravitationalConstant = -40)
  #)%>%
  visOptions(highlightNearest=list(enabled= TRUE,degree=1,"hideColor"="gray"),nodesIdSelection = list(
    enabled = TRUE,
    useLabels = TRUE,
    values = only_domaine,
    main = "Domaine, secteur :" 
  ), selectedBy = list(
      variable = "id",
      values=c(only_ecoles),
      main = "Écoles, magistères :",
      multiple = TRUE,"hideColor"="gray", sort=TRUE, highlight=TRUE)) %>% 
    visInteraction(selectable = TRUE,navigationButtons = TRUE, zoomView = FALSE) %>% 
  visGroups(groupname = "X-ENS", color = list(
      background = "#cea2e4",
      border = "#cea2e4",
      highlight = "#cea2e4"
    ),font = list(size = 32) ) %>%
  visGroups(groupname = "Mines-Ponts",color= list(
      background ="#FFD700" ,
      border = "#FFD700",
      highlight = "#FFD700" 
    ),font = list(size = 32) ) %>%
    visGroups(groupname = "Mines-Telecom",color= list(
      background = "orange",
      border ="orange" ,
      shape="ellipse",
      highlight = "orange"),font = list(size = 32)) %>%
   visGroups(groupname = "Centrale-Supelec", color= list(
      background ="lightgreen" ,
      shape="ellipse",
      border ="lightgreen" ,
      highlight = "lightgreen"),font = list(size = 32)) %>%
  visGroups(groupname = "CCINP", color =list(
      background = "lightblue",
      border = "lightblue",
      highlight ="lightblue"),font = list(size = 32)) %>%
      visGroups(groupname = "INP-PC-Chimie", color =list(
      background = "#0080ff",
      border = "#0080ff",
      highlight = "#0080ff"),font = list(size = 32)) %>%
      visGroups(groupname = "Banque_CCINP_ou_IF", color =list(
      background = "#2F5FD7",
      border ="#2F5FD7" ,
      highlight = "#2F5FD7"),font = list(size = 32)) %>%
      visGroups(groupname = "Groupe_INSA", color =list(
      background = "#2EA84F",
      border = "#2EA84F",
      highlight = "#2EA84F" ),font = list(size = 32))%>%
      visGroups(groupname = "e3a-POLYTECH", color =list(
      background ="#6e9363" ,
      border = "#6e9363",
      highlight = "#6e9363"),font = list(size = 32))%>%
      visGroups(groupname = "EPITA_ISME_IPSA", color =list(
      background = "#ffcc99",
      border = "#ffcc99",
      highlight = "#ffcc99"),font = list(size = 32))%>%
      visGroups(groupname = "BCEAS", color =list(
      background = "#7469C1",
      border = "#7469C1",
      highlight = "#7469C1"),font = list(size = 32))%>%
      visGroups(groupname = "Magisteres", color =list(
      background = "#9B59B6",
      border = "#9B59B6",
      highlight = "#9B59B6"),font = list(size = 32))%>%
  visGroups(groupname = "Domaine", color =list(background="pink",size = 24,border="#e862a5",highlight="#e862a5") ,shape="diamond",font=list(color="#FF69B4", size = 32))  %>%
      visNodes(color = list(background = "white", font = list(color = "white"))) %>%
  visClusteringByGroup(groups = c("X-ENS","Mines-Ponts","Mines-Telecom", "Centrale-Supelec","CCINP","INP-PC-Chimie","Banque_CCINP_ou_IF","Groupe_INSA", "e3a-POLYTECH","EPITA_ISME_IPSA","BCEAS","Magisteres"), label = "Concours ", color="white") %>%
  visLegend() %>%
  htmlwidgets::onRender("
    function(el) {
      let legendItems = el.querySelectorAll('.vis-legend .vis-legend-label');
      legendItems.forEach(function(label) {
      label.size=28;
        label.style.whiteSpace = 'normal';
        label.style.width = '100px';  // largeur forcée
        label.style.wordBreak = 'break-word';
      });
    }
  ")%>%
    visEvents(afterDrawing = htmlwidgets::JS("
      function(ctx) {
        var network = this;

        // Si pas de drapeau, on le crée
        if(!network._handledNodes) network._handledNodes = {};

        var selected = network.getSelectedNodes();

        if(selected.length === 1){
          var nodeId = selected[0];

          // Si on n'a pas déjà planifié la désélection pour ce nœud
          if(!network._handledNodes[nodeId]){
            network._handledNodes[nodeId] = true;

            // Envoie à Shiny
            Shiny.setInputValue('selected_node', nodeId, {priority:'event'});

            // Désélection automatique après 3 secondes
            setTimeout(function(){
              network.unselectNode(nodeId);
              network._handledNodes[nodeId] = false; // réinitialise
            }, 3000);
          }
        }
      }
    "),deselectNode = htmlwidgets::JS("
    function() {
      Shiny.setInputValue('selected_node', null);
    }
  "),selectNode = htmlwidgets::JS("
    function(params) {
      var network = this;
if(params.nodes.length > 0){
          Shiny.setInputValue('selected_node', nodeId, {priority:'event'});
        }
      // Vérifie qu'un seul nœud est sélectionné
      if (params.nodes.length !== 1) return;

      var nodeId = params.nodes[0];
      var node = network.body.nodes[nodeId];
      Shiny.setInputValue('selected_node', nodeId, {priority: 'event'});
      setTimeout(function(){
              this.unselectNode(nodeId);
            }.bind(this), 3000);

      // Si c'est un cluster reformé (clic sur +)
      if (node && node.isCluster === true) {
        // Récupère les IDs des nœuds dans ce cluster
        var childNodeIds = network.getNodesInCluster(nodeId);

        if (childNodeIds.length === 0) return;

        // Récupère le premier nœud pour connaître sa couleur
        var firstChild = network.body.nodes[childNodeIds[0]];
        if (!firstChild) return;

        var colorData = firstChild.options.color;
        var backgroundColor = (typeof colorData === 'string') ? colorData : colorData.background;

        // Appliquer cette couleur au cluster
        node.setOptions({
          color: {
            background: backgroundColor,
            border: nodeColor,
            highlight: {
              background: backgroundColor,
              border: 'nodeColor'
            }
          },
          font: {
          color: nodeColor,
            size: 30
          }
        });

        network.redraw();
      }
    }
  "),stabilized = "function() {
  

      this.body.nodeIndices.forEach(function(nodeId) {
        var node = this.body.nodes[nodeId];
        if (node.isCluster === true) {
        var nodeColor = node.options.color.background
          node.setOptions({
            color: {
            background: nodeColor,
            border: nodeColor,
            highlight: nodeColor
            },
            font: {
              color:nodeColor,
              background: 'black',
              size: 30
            }
          });
        }
      }.bind(this));
      this.redraw();
    }",select = "function(nodes) {
      Shiny.setInputValue('selected_node', nodes.nodes[0],{priority: 'event'});
    }")
  
  
  })
  
  
  
  
  
output$info <-renderText({
 req(input$selected_node)
s1=input$selected_group_js

selected_id <- input$selected_node
if (!(is.null(s1))){
  selected_id=selected_group_js}
 else  if (is.null(selected_id)) {selected_id <- input$graph_nodesIdSelection}
  req(input$selected_node)
  


  
 #print(selected_id)
 
  if (selected_id %in% only_domaine){
  selected_group <- nodes$group[nodes$id == selected_id]

  if (selected_group == "Domaine") {
    related_ids <- edges$from[edges$to == selected_id]
    related_labels <- nodes$label[nodes$id %in% related_ids]
    related_nodes <- nodes$group[which(nodes$id %in% related_ids) ]
    related_lien_ecole <- nodes$lien_ecole[which(nodes$id %in% related_ids) ]
    related_lien_concours <- nodes$lien_concours[which(nodes$id %in% related_ids) ]

    if (length(related_labels) == 0) {
      return(HTML(paste0("Aucune école ou magistère liée au domaine <em>", selected_id, "</em>")))
    }
items <- paste0(
      "<a href='", related_lien_ecole, "' target='_blank'>", related_labels, "</a>"
    )

items_concours <- paste0(
      "<a href='", related_lien_concours, "' target='_blank'>", related_nodes, "</a>"
    )
#<strong style='font-size:12px;'>style='font-size:12px;'
    HTML(paste0(
      "<span style='font-size: 0.7em;'>","Faites dérouler la liste des écoles, magistères liés au domaine  <em>", selected_id, "  (places offertes par filière & domaine à vérifier) : </span></em> </strong>","<span style='font-size: 1em;'>",
      "<ul >", paste0("<li>", items," (", items_concours, ") ","</li> </span>", collapse = ""), "</ul>"
    ))
}
  } else if (selected_id %in% only_ecoles) {
    related_ids <- edges$to[edges$from == selected_id]
    related_labels <- nodes$label[nodes$id %in% related_ids & nodes$group == "Domaine"]

    if (length(related_labels) == 0) {
      return(HTML(paste0("Aucun domaine lié à l'école ou magistère <em>", selected_id, "</em>")))
    }
    
related_lien_ecole <- nodes$lien_ecole[which(nodes$id==selected_id) ]
conc=nodes$group[which(nodes$id==selected_id)]
related_lien_concours <- nodes$lien_concours[which(nodes$group==nodes$group[which(nodes$id==selected_id)]) ][1]

    items <- paste0(
      "<a href='",related_lien_ecole , "' target='_blank'>", selected_id, "</a>"
    )
    items_c <- paste0(
      "<a href='",related_lien_concours , "' target='_blank'>", conc, "</a>"
    )

    HTML(paste0(
      "<strong>Faites dérouler les domaines liés à <em>", items," (",items_c,")", "</em> :</strong>",
      "<ul>", paste0("<li>", related_labels, "</li>", collapse = ""), "</ul>"
    ))

  } else if (any(str_detect(selected_id, only_concours))) {
     selected_id=na.omit(str_extract(selected_id,only_concours))
    
if (length(selected_id)==2){
  selected_id=selected_id[2]
}
     
     
     related_lien_ecole <- nodes$lien_ecole[which(nodes$group==selected_id) ]
     
ec=nodes$id[which(nodes$group==selected_id)]
related_lien_concours <- nodes$lien_concours[which(nodes$group==selected_id)][1]
    # HTML(paste0(""))
     items_c <- paste0(
      "<a href='",related_lien_concours , "' target='_blank'>", selected_id, "</a>"
    )
     items <- paste0(
      "<a href='",related_lien_ecole , "' target='_blank'>", ec, "</a>"
    )
    HTML(paste0(
      "<span style='font-size: 0.7em;font-weight:strong;'>","Faites dérouler la liste des écoles, magistères du cluster <em>", items_c," (recliquez sur le cluster pour le déplier sur le graphe):</span>", "</em> ", "<ul>", paste0("<li>", items," (",items_c,")", "</li>", collapse = ""), "</ul>"
    )) 
     
     
     #items_concours <- paste0(
    #  "<a href='", related_lien_concours, "' target='_blank'>", related_nodes, "</a>"
   # )
    #HTML(paste0(
   #   "<ul style='font-size:12px;'>", paste0("<li>", items," (", items_concours, ") ","</li>", collapse = ""), "</ul>"
 #   ))
  } 
  else
    {
    HTML("<em>Type de nœud non reconnu.</em>")
  }
})
```
